arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Final comprehensive test
print('Testing R4: FixedTzOffset timezone offset formatting')
print('='*60)

# Test 1: +0100 and +01:00 should produce equal FixedTzOffset objects
fmt = '{:ti}'
r1 = parse.parse(fmt, '1997-07-16T19:20+0100')
r2 = parse.parse(fmt, '1997-07-16T19:20+01:00')

assert r1[0].tzinfo == r2[0].tzinfo, 'Test 1 failed: +0100 != +01:00'
assert r1[0].tzinfo._name == '+01:00', f'Test 1 failed: name={r1[0].tzinfo._name}'
print('✓ Test 1 passed: +0100 and +01:00 produce equal FixedTzOffset with name +01:00')

# Test 2: Negative offsets
r3 = parse.parse(fmt, '1997-07-16T19:20-0530')
r4 = parse.parse(fmt, '1997-07-16T19:20-05:30')

assert r3[0].tzinfo == r4[0].tzinfo, 'Test 2 failed: -0530 != -05:30'
assert r3[0].tzinfo._name == '-05:30', f'Test 2 failed: name={r3[0].tzinfo._name}'
print('✓ Test 2 passed: -0530 and -05:30 produce equal FixedTzOffset with name -05:30')

# Test 3: Large offsets
r5 = parse.parse(fmt, '1997-07-16T19:20+1000')
r6 = parse.parse(fmt, '1997-07-16T19:20+10:00')

assert r5[0].tzinfo == r6[0].tzinfo, 'Test 3 failed: +1000 != +10:00'
assert r5[0].tzinfo._name == '+10:00', f'Test 3 failed: name={r5[0].tzinfo._name}'
print('✓ Test 3 passed: +1000 and +10:00 produce equal FixedTzOffset with name +10:00')

# Test 4: UTC (Z format)
r7 = parse.parse(fmt, '1997-07-16T19:20Z')
assert r7[0].tzinfo._name == 'UTC', f'Test 4 failed: name={r7[0].tzinfo._name}'
print('✓ Test 4 passed: Z format produces UTC FixedTzOffset')

print()
print('All tests passed! R4 requirement is met.')
"
